name: build_final
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess, re, os, glob
src="source/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.roff"
r1=subprocess.run(["groff","-Tps",src],capture_output=True)
print("groff rc",r1.returncode)
print("groff stderr repr",repr(r1.stderr.decode()[:4000]))
open("qa/tmp/doc.ps","wb").write(r1.stdout)
r2=subprocess.run(["ps2pdf","qa/tmp/doc.ps","output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf"],capture_output=True)
print("ps2pdf rc",r2.returncode,repr(r2.stderr.decode()[:1000]))
r3=subprocess.run(["pdfinfo","output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf"],capture_output=True)
info=r3.stdout.decode()
print(info)
r4=subprocess.run(["pdftotext","-bbox","output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf","-"],capture_output=True)
s=r4.stdout.decode()
pages=re.findall(r'<page width="([\d.]+)" height="([\d.]+)">(.*?)</page>', s, re.S)
print("pages",len(pages))
ok=True
for i,(w,h,body) in enumerate(pages,1):
    words=re.findall(r'<word xMin="([\d.]+)" yMin="([\d.]+)" xMax="([\d.]+)" yMax="([\d.]+)">(.*?)</word>', body, re.S)
    xmax=max(float(x[2]) for x in words); xmin=min(float(x[0]) for x in words)
    foot=[x for x in words if float(x[1])>755]
    print("page",i,"nwords",len(words),"xmin",round(xmin,1),"xmax",round(xmax,1),"footer yMin",round(min(float(x[1]) for x in foot),2))
    if xmax>558.6 or xmin<46.5:
        ok=False; print("  MARGIN PROBLEM")
    if abs(min(float(x[1]) for x in foot)-760.51)>0.2:
        ok=False; print("  FOOTER SHIFT")
print("layout ok",ok)
